result.final_text:
## What this letter says

You went to the hospital emergency department. You fell at home and hit your head. You did not pass out (no loss of consciousness).

The hospital did some tests:

- An X-ray of your right hip showed no broken bone (no fracture).
- A detailed X-ray scan of your head (CT scan) showed no bleeding inside your head.
- Your blood pressure was 142/80 when you were lying down. It was 108/66 when you were standing up.

This means your blood pressure drops when you stand up (postural hypotension). Your medicine amlodipine may be causing this.

## What you need to do

1. Stop taking amlodipine 10 mg.
2. Keep taking all your other medicines.
3. Stand up slowly. Sit on the edge of the bed for a minute before you stand.
4. The hospital has referred you to the Falls Prevention Clinic. The clinic will write to you with an appointment.
5. Your family doctor (GP) will check your blood pressure again in 4 weeks. They will check it while you are lying down and while you are standing up.

## Dates and medicines

**Dates**
- The hospital saw you on 14 October 2026. This date is later than today, so it may be a typing mistake.
- Your GP will check your blood pressure again in 4 weeks.
- The Falls Prevention Clinic will write to you with a date.

**Medicines**
- Amlodipine 10 mg: **stop** taking this. It may be making your blood pressure drop when you stand.
- All your other medicines: **keep taking** them.

## Questions to ask your doctor

1. The letter says I was seen on 14 October 2026. Is this date correct?
2. What does "postural hypotension" mean for me?
3. Will I need a different medicine instead of amlodipine?
4. What will happen at the Falls Prevention Clinic?

## When to get urgent help

Call 999 or go to the hospital emergency department (A&E) if you get any of these in the next few days:

- a headache that gets worse
- being sick (vomiting)
- feeling confused
- feeling very sleepy (drowsiness)

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
